text.en: Sherlock Holmes seems to be dying, and only Watson can be brought to his bedside.

Mrs. Hudson, Holmes's landlady, tells Watson that Holmes has been sinking for three days and will not let a doctor come. Watson finds his friend weak and strange, and Holmes does not let him treat him. Holmes then sets a trap for the man who he believes caused the illness.
The story teaches that appearances may deceive and that a clever mind uses cunning to catch a criminal. It shows Holmes's brilliant planning and Watson's loyalty.
Learn the words landlady, sinking, deceive, trap and clue. Detective stories build suspense through hints and a final surprise.
